about_the_game:
"Cultivation Magic World" — A Single-Player RPG Featuring Treasure Hunting, Immortal Cultivation, and Relaxed Idle Gameplay

In the Cultivation Magic World, you will embark on a free and boundless path to immortality — no tedious quests, battle the moment you log in; no complicated controls, just one-click idle combat to automatically hunt treasures, gather resources, and grow with ease.

Content Overview

  • Diverse Class Paths: Choose your own way of cultivation. Sword Cultivators excel at fierce offense to overwhelm enemies, Body Cultivators rely on ironclad defense to claim victory, while Flame Mages, Ice Mages, Thunder Mages, and Beast Tamers each bring unique playstyles to suit different preferences.

  • Talents & Physique System: Unlock rare physiques such as the Ancient Sacred Body or the Innate Dao Embryo, shaping your growth path and battle strategy.

  • From Common Gear to Divine Artifacts, Enjoy the Thrill of Loot Hunting: Defeat monsters, elites, and bosses to obtain equipment. Whether it's common mortal gear or legendary immortal weapons, all can be enhanced, reforged, and awakened, offering endless collection fun.

  • Tame Spirit Beasts to Aid Your Journey: Capture monsters as your spirit beasts — whether serving as sturdy tanks, magic damage dealers, or support healers, they are your best allies in conquering the cultivation realm.

  • Realm Advancement, Step-by-Step Breakthroughs: Progress from Body Tempering and Qi Refining to Foundation Establishment, Core Formation, Nascent Soul, and beyond — toward Deification and the Grand Ascension stage. Break through continuously until you reach the Immortal Realm or even the Divine Realm, experiencing the full rhythm of cultivation.

  • Seamless Idle Gameplay for Relaxed Enjoyment: Supports one-click idle mode, allowing both autonomous exploration and resource accumulation — perfect for casual players, while hands-on players can jump in at any time for manual control.

Game Background

Some are born at the pinnacle of life, while others are born to toil like oxen and horses. What meaning do life and death, glory and wealth truly hold? And what is the meaning of life itself?

With these questions in mind, you step into the game <Cultivation Magic World>. The "Game Spirit"—transformed from the "Spirit of the Cosmic Cultivation System"—will guide you on your journey of cultivation.

Mortal Realm Arc

Life has an end; only by cultivating to become stronger can you extend your lifespan. To escape death, you start as a mortal, begin cultivating, and become a cultivator, officially kicking off your (Immortal Cultivation) journey.

Yet when you reach the peak of the Mortal Realm, you hit a bottleneck—no more progress, and your lifespan continues to fade day by day. Becoming an immortal is your only way out. But the path to immortality is treacherous: the Immortal Gate Guards are powerful, and you are no match for them. You have no choice but to reincarnate repeatedly, honing your strength each time.

Finally, one day, you defeat the Immortal Gate Guards, survive the Heavenly Tribulation of Immortality, and attain an Immortal Body.

Immortal Realm Arc

Immortal Cultivation! Immortal Cultivation! Now you are an immortal, yet you still haven’t found the answers. Though immortality extends your lifespan, it still has an end. You begin to fight and conquer in the Immortal Realm, eventually becoming its strongest being.

Since the Immortal Realm holds no answers, you decide to head to the Divine Realm. You keep accumulating power, and in the end, you shatter the void and set foot on the Divine Path.

Divine Realm Arc

Truth Cultivation! Truth Cultivation! What truly is (Truth Cultivation)? The things you once cherished as treasures in the Mortal and Immortal Realms now seem utterly useless. It’s just like life—all you fought so hard for fades into nothingness after a hundred or a thousand years.

If everything in the world is empty and an illusion, then what is real? What is the true goal of Truth Cultivation? Perhaps the Dao Realm holds the answer.

Dao Realm Arc

"The Dao that can be told is not the eternal Dao; the name that can be named is not the eternal name. Void/Non is the origin of heaven and earth; Existence/Being is the mother of all things. The Dao is born from Void—but what exactly is the Dao?

"The Dao gives birth to One; One gives birth to Two; Two gives birth to Three; Three gives birth to all things." It seems the Dao itself is the ultimate truth.

You thus embark on a journey to seek the Dao. As you walk this path, you gradually realize: all things in heaven and earth, everything in the world, are manifestations of the Dao—including yourself.

Transcendence

At last, you understand: the Dao has always been within you! We ourselves are the Dao, we are the Buddha—we are inherently complete. We are just blinded by desires and habitual tendencies, so this true nature cannot shine forth. Letting go is the Dao; letting go is being the Buddha.

Cultivation is about correcting one’s actions, learning to let go, and revealing one’s innate Buddha-nature. This is what is called (Seeing One’s True Nature).

So, what is the meaning of life? This life is not the end—it is just a segment of the long journey of cultivation. Excessive craving for desires is demonic nature; letting go is Buddha-nature. One thought turns you into a demon; one thought makes you a Buddha!

Refund Notes

My English skills are limited, so if there are unclear or confusing translations in the game, I apologize in advance! I sincerely hope more people can enjoy this cultivation - themed fun, so I still released the English version.

You can request a refund if your playtime is ≤2 hours after purchase. If the game isn’t your cup of tea, to ensure a smooth refund, it’s recommended to submit the request when your playtime reaches around 1.5 hours — this helps avoid issues with exceeding the refund time limit.

Player Communication
